help.text: Open SmartView with the instance link (globe icon). Pages and tiles are set up in the app itself (✎ at the top right). For push notifications on the iPhone install the certificate once: page /zertifikat.

https.label: HTTPS with own certificate (needed for push notifications)

certCollection.label: Certificate collection of the acme adapter (optional)
certCollection.help: Empty = own SmartView certificate (install once per device). With a Let's Encrypt certificate from the acme adapter (e.g. collection 'default') nothing has to be installed on the devices; then enter the domain as address below.

publicHost.label: Address of the ioBroker server (optional)
publicHost.help: Empty = detected automatically. Also used for the certificate.

accessKey.label: Access key (optional)
accessKey.help: If set, SmartView must be opened once with ?key=... per device

allowEdit.label: Allow editing in the app
allowEdit.help: Switch off when the layout is finished, so nobody changes it by accident

usersOff.label: Switch users off (emergency, e.g. forgotten password)
usersOff.help: Users are set up in the app (menu → Benutzer). Tick this only to get in again without a password, then set a new one and untick it.

remoteHeader.text: Access from outside (own server as reverse proxy)

proxyIps.label: Address(es) of the reverse proxy
proxyIps.help: e.g. 10.77.0.1 (WireGuard address of the VPS). Requests from there count as 'from outside': a user login is always required (set up users first). Empty = off.

options.label: everything as at home (PIN still asked)

externalUrl.label: Address from outside (for links in messages)
externalUrl.help: e.g. https://smartview.example.com - Telegram/WhatsApp/push links then work everywhere
